facts.text: Deborah organized a yoga event that included yoga sessions, food stalls, and live music.

evidence.quote: I reached out to different nearby businesses and places to make it happen. We had yoga, food stalls, and even some live music - it was amazing!

facts.text: Deborah suggests prioritizing and managing time effectively to maintain a balance between hobbies and studies.

evidence.quote: As for balancing hobbies and studies, I find it helpful to prioritize and manage my time effectively. Making a schedule and setting aside specific time for studying and pursuing hobbies can go a long way in maintaining balance.

facts.text: Deborah used to play video games but has not played them in a while.

evidence.quote: I used to play some video games, but it's been a while.

facts.text: Jolene bought a console for her partner on the 17th of August and has been playing video games with him.

evidence.quote: I bought a console for my partner as a gift on the 17th and it's so much fun, he even managed to play it.
